LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapace.label: Symbiotic Carapace
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapace.description: A living armor shell that slowly repairs ordinary wounds while worn. Regeneration consumes the wearer's metabolism: hunger rises 50% faster, and each repair adds symbiotic strain. It pauses while the wearer is hungry.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilArmor.label: Phaseveil Armor
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilArmor.description: A light phase-distortion suit. Select its wearer and activate Phaseveil to become invisible for up to 20 seconds; the ability has a 90-second cooldown. Attacking or being downed ends the effect. Active cloaking builds neural fatigue, which recovers faster during rest.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightAbsorberArmor.label: Blight Absorber Armor
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightAbsorberArmor.description: On polluted ground, this armor absorbs nearby pollution into a reserve of up to 100 energy. Its active shield can spend that reserve to absorb incoming damage. Pollution absorption and shield activation slowly build toxic accumulation.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_RetaliatorCarapace.label: Retaliator Carapace
LanguageData.LiAIChat_RetaliatorCarapace.description: This living shell grows venomous spines that can retaliate against damaging melee attacks. Each retaliation causes dermal erosion; the spines cannot respond to ranged or environmental damage.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ResonanceMantle.label: Resonance Mantle
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ResonanceMantle.description: Activate a short-range resonance field to disrupt nearby hostile biological enemies. The field strains the wearer's nervous system and has a long cooldown.
